groups.assessment: Malformed function/string grammar in the selected strict Module source.

evidence.rule: A string literal must terminate; a function declaration needs its syntactic components.
Function declarations require their name, parameter list and body under this grammar.

groups.assessment: Malformed type syntax or a decorator attached to an interface; this assessment concerns TypeScript syntax, not type-checking.

evidence.rule: Aliases require a type and property signatures require their type after a colon; decorators do not decorate interfaces.
Decorators apply to the documented class and class-member declaration forms.

groups.assessment: A hashbang marker is split, duplicated, nested or preceded by source characters, including BOM, in original Module text.

evidence.rule: HashbangComment is available only in the initial input element; source is not stripped or reparsed.

groups.assessment: Duplicate parameters or eval binding in a strict Module function.

evidence.rule: Strict formal parameters cannot duplicate binding names or bind eval/arguments.

groups.assessment: Legacy octal escape is forbidden in strict Module source.

evidence.rule: Strict-mode string literals exclude legacy octal escape sequences.

groups.assessment: Break or continue has no enclosing permitted target.

evidence.rule: Unlabelled break needs a surrounding iteration/switch; continue needs an iteration.
The continue target must enclose the statement.

groups.assessment: A block declares the same lexical value binding twice.

evidence.rule: Duplicate LexicallyDeclaredNames are an early error; a same-name type declaration alone is different.

groups.assessment: An array literal is not a simple target for compound assignment.

evidence.rule: Compound assignment requires a simple assignment target; array destructuring is available for plain equals assignment.

groups.assessment: The original UTF-8 source exceeds the explicit PoC byte budget.

evidence.rule: 16 KiB original source bytes is a resource restriction, not a language validity judgment.

groups.assessment: An expression exceeds the explicit source expression nesting budget.

evidence.rule: expression nesting 128 is a resource restriction, not a language validity judgment.

groups.assessment: A predicate exceeds the explicit source predicate nesting budget.

evidence.rule: predicate nesting 128 is a resource restriction, not a language validity judgment.

groups.assessment: Statements exceed the explicit source statement nesting budget.

evidence.rule: statement nesting 64 is a resource restriction, not a language validity judgment.

groups.assessment: Source statements, directives and type declarations exceed the shared statement budget.

evidence.rule: 256 statements is a resource restriction, not a language validity judgment.

groups.assessment: Source value bindings exceed the cumulative source-local budget.

evidence.rule: 128 source locals is a resource restriction, not a language validity judgment.

groups.assessment: Exponentiation or exponentiation assignment is valid but not lowered.

evidence.rule: Exponentiation has specified Number semantics.

observableDone: Admit Number exponentiation and selected assignment forms with standard corner cases and operand-order tests.

groups.assessment: Initialized mutable Number identifiers admit &&= and ||= with selected RHS evaluation, a selected Store and captured results. Nullish assignment, const assignment admission and general value storage remain outside this profile.

evidence.rule: Logical assignments short circuit and evaluate their assignment target once.

observableDone: Admit logical/nullish assignments for a specified value domain with RHS-selection, target and stored-result tests.

groups.assessment: Null/undefined values and nullish coalescing exceed the current numeric representation.

evidence.rule: Nullish selection distinguishes null/undefined from other falsy values.

observableDone: Define the value representation and admit null/undefined selection with selected/unselected effect tests.

groups.assessment: Immutable Boolean locals admit predicate-position reads and unary +, - and ~ and binary arithmetic +, -, *, / and % reads of initialized immutable Predicate bindings. Inline Boolean-producing shapes also convert to Number for binary +, -, *, / and %. Same-kind strict ===/!== predicates also admit two selected inline or initialized immutable Predicate operands through the existing Number bridge. Mutable storage, bare Boolean binding operands outside those unary, arithmetic and strict predicate bridges, Boolean arguments/results and general coercion remain outside admission. Discarded inline Number/Boolean evaluation and bare/wrapped initialized immutable Predicate identifier reads are admitted. This leaf eligibility does not widen root logical/conditional/sequence classification, mutable storage or other value positions.

evidence.rule: Comparisons and negation produce Boolean values; numeric operations apply the standard conversions.

observableDone: Specify Boolean storage/result boundaries and admit the represented operations with coercion and effect-order tests.

groups.assessment: String expressions or string conversions are valid but outside numeric admission.

evidence.rule: Addition may concatenate strings; other numeric operations apply their specified conversions.

observableDone: Represent the required strings and verify concatenation/conversion and discarded-expression behavior.

groups.assessment: Object values, properties and object coercion require runtime value support.

evidence.rule: Object initializers produce objects; property access and conversion have independent runtime semantics.

observableDone: Admit the represented object/property operations with identity, conversion and exception tests.

groups.assessment: Array values and indexed access require runtime values and property semantics.

evidence.rule: Array initializers create objects with indexed properties.

observableDone: Admit arrays and indexed reads with independent numeric/result and identity tests.

groups.assessment: BigInt operations and mixed Number/BigInt expressions are valid source and may throw at runtime.

evidence.rule: Numeric operators distinguish Number and BigInt; unsupported mixtures can throw TypeError.

observableDone: Specify BigInt representation and verify arithmetic, shifts, comparisons and mixed-domain errors.

groups.assessment: Equality involving non-Number values requires the standard coercion algorithms.

evidence.rule: Loose equality is distinct from strict equality and performs type-dependent conversions.

observableDone: Admit selected mixed-type equalities with independent standard-derived coercion cases.

groups.assessment: typeof expressions require String results and special unresolved-reference behavior.

evidence.rule: typeof handles unresolvable references specially and returns a String.

observableDone: Admit typeof with known values, unresolvable names and TDZ exception tests.

groups.assessment: void expressions require Undefined results while preserving operand effects.

evidence.rule: void evaluates its operand and yields undefined.

observableDone: Admit void with operand-effect and Undefined-result tests.

groups.assessment: delete requires property/reference semantics and Boolean results.

evidence.rule: Delete evaluates references and handles property deletion.

observableDone: Admit selected deletion forms with property outcomes, effects and errors.

groups.assessment: The in operator requires object/property semantics.

evidence.rule: The in operator checks a property key against an object and can throw.

observableDone: Admit in with property-key conversion, inherited-property and non-object error tests.

groups.assessment: instanceof requires constructor/prototype and callable behavior.

evidence.rule: InstanceofOperator performs the specified instance test.

observableDone: Admit selected instance checks with prototype and error cases.

groups.assessment: Indirect, property, wrapped-callee, spread, generic and non-exact-arity calls remain outside the direct numeric call subset; unsupported calls in unselected source still reject.

evidence.rule: Call evaluation evaluates the callee/arguments and invokes the callable; unselected runtime branches need not execute.

observableDone: Admit a specified callable domain with argument order, return, selected-branch and capability tests.

groups.assessment: Captured bindings and nested function declarations need function/environment lifetime support.

evidence.rule: Function creation captures its lexical environment.

observableDone: Admit nested/capturing functions with mutable capture and lifetime tests.

groups.assessment: Nested recursive function declarations still need lexical function/environment support; top-level direct numeric recursion is admitted with existing runtime protections.

evidence.rule: A function binding can be called recursively.

observableDone: Admit recursive calls with finite reference cases and explicit stack/fuel behavior.

groups.assessment: Classes, construction and methods require object and function runtime semantics.

evidence.rule: Class definitions establish constructors and methods.

observableDone: Admit selected class construction and method behavior with independent result tests.

groups.assessment: Generator functions and iterators exceed the synchronous numeric entry.

evidence.rule: Generators suspend/resume through iterator results.

observableDone: Admit generator execution with yield/resume and completion tests.

groups.assessment: Async functions/await require Promise and job execution semantics.

evidence.rule: Async functions return Promises and await schedules continuation.

observableDone: Specify and admit Promise/job behavior with completion and rejection tests.

groups.assessment: Imports, exports and extra runtime module items are valid source beyond the PoC entry contract.

evidence.rule: Module linking and evaluation are separate from parsing and exported function selection.

observableDone: Specify module graph/initialization and entry selection, then admit these shapes with linking/evaluation tests.

groups.assessment: Valid modules may use other entry names, arities, export forms or no runtime entry.

evidence.rule: The single named two-Number run entry is a PoC contract, not ECMAScript validity.

observableDone: Specify and test additional entry/export/arity forms without marking excluded forms invalid.

groups.assessment: Defaults, rest, destructuring, optional and this parameters require parameter binding/erasure beyond the PoC shape.

evidence.rule: Function parameter initialization has distinct default/rest/destructuring behavior.
TypeScript optional and this parameters are source type syntax; runtime behavior follows the erased function.

observableDone: Admit selected parameter forms with binding order, defaults, rest and original-TS erasure tests.

groups.assessment: var declarations and hoisting need function-scoped initialization semantics.

evidence.rule: VarDeclaredNames and function instantiation establish var bindings before body evaluation.

observableDone: Admit var declaration/hoisting and shadowing with before-declaration read tests.

groups.assessment: Uninitialized let and definite-assignment syntax are valid source, outside initialized numeric locals.

evidence.rule: A let declaration without initializer initializes to undefined; TS definite assertions do not create runtime checks.
Definite-assignment assertions communicate to the checker, without supplying a runtime initializer.

observableDone: Admit uninitialized let/definite syntax with initialization, Undefined and TDZ tests.

groups.assessment: Binding or assignment destructuring requires pattern/iterator/property evaluation.

evidence.rule: Destructuring evaluates the RHS and initializes or assigns pattern targets; Number RHS can throw.

observableDone: Admit selected binding/plain-assignment patterns with order, iterator/property access and error tests.

groups.assessment: Assignments/updates to const bindings are valid source and throw TypeError only if evaluated.

evidence.rule: SetMutableBinding throws for immutable bindings; an unselected branch may avoid the write.

observableDone: Represent and verify runtime immutable-binding errors, including unselected writes; do not misclassify source as invalid.

groups.assessment: TDZ reads/writes and unresolved references are valid source, possibly unselected; evaluation may throw ReferenceError.

evidence.rule: Uninitialized lexical reads throw at runtime; scope/hoisting determine resolution.
GetValue of an unresolvable reference throws ReferenceError; unresolved names are not a parse error.

observableDone: Admit binding-error paths with ReferenceError outcomes and unselected-path success tests.

groups.assessment: Writes to standard Infinity/NaN globals are valid source and fail at runtime if evaluated.

evidence.rule: Infinity/NaN are non-writable global properties; strict writes throw through PutValue.

observableDone: Verify strict writes to immutable globals and unselected-write behavior with independent exception outcomes.

groups.assessment: Property assignment/update targets require object and strict property-write semantics.

evidence.rule: Assignment evaluates a reference then writes it; Number primitive properties may fail in strict mode.

observableDone: Admit property writes/updates with reference capture, strict primitive errors and effect-order tests.

groups.assessment: Valid function bodies can fall through, return undefined, diverge or return through paths beyond conservative analysis.

evidence.rule: Return without expression yields undefined; a function need not structurally return a Number.

observableDone: Specify additional completion/result contracts and admit corresponding paths with bounded numeric, Undefined and divergence tests.

groups.assessment: Valid unreachable runtime statements are rejected by conservative source admission.

evidence.rule: StatementList propagates abrupt completion and does not evaluate the runtime suffix.

observableDone: Admit and validate unreachable source without executing its suffix or changing completion alternatives.

groups.assessment: Labelled statements/break/continue require label target resolution.

evidence.rule: Labels determine the appropriate break/continue target.

observableDone: Admit label resolution with nested nearest/outer targets and bounded execution tests.

groups.assessment: Switch requires case selection, fallthrough and break completion.

evidence.rule: CaseBlock evaluates matching clauses and propagates completion.

observableDone: Admit switch selection/fallthrough with default and break tests.

groups.assessment: for-in/for-of require enumeration or iterator semantics.

evidence.rule: Enumeration and iterator binding are distinct from ordinary numeric for loops.

observableDone: Admit selected enumeration/iteration forms with ordering, bindings and iterator-close tests.

groups.assessment: Throw/catch/finally need exception values and completion/unwinding semantics.

evidence.rule: Finally can replace or preserve prior completion, including return/break/continue.

observableDone: Admit exception completion and cleanup with bounded throw/catch/finally composition tests.

groups.assessment: Declaration-level type-only imports and exports erase without runtime module edges. Ambient value/function declarations and global/module augmentations remain outside this profile.

evidence.rule: Type-only module syntax is distinct from runtime imports; ambient declarations describe external values.

observableDone: Classify and admit the selected type module forms with original-source retention and no invented runtime values.

groups.assessment: Namespaces, enums and runtime generic/ambient function forms require their separate emission or admission decisions.

evidence.rule: Enums and namespaces can emit runtime code; generic type parameters erase but do not grant runtime entry admission.
Namespaces organize value and type declarations and can emit code.

observableDone: Specify each supported declaration form and verify its actual runtime emission/erasure and binding behavior.

groups.assessment: Function values, this and arguments require runtime function/context representation.

evidence.rule: This/identifier/arguments evaluation follows the execution context and value domain.

observableDone: Specify function/context representations and test function references, strict this and arguments behavior.

groups.assessment: A helper exceeds the backend limit of 1000 parameters.

evidence.rule: The 1000-parameter backend resource cap is separate from ECMAScript source validity.

groups.assessment: Writes to resolved module function bindings require mutable callable selection beyond statically resolved direct calls, including writes in unselected or unused bodies.

evidence.rule: Mutable function bindings may be assigned; a static call target cannot ignore writes which may change its value.

observableDone: Represent mutable function bindings and test writes, subsequent calls, selected paths and non-callable outcomes.

groups.assessment: Math/global builtin mutation and reification require mutable realm objects and value semantics; the numeric execution profile supplies only pristine Math.abs/sqrt/floor/ceil/trunc intrinsics.

evidence.rule: The Math property is a writable, configurable global property; it must not be treated as an immutable ECMAScript object binding.
Math methods are ordinary builtin function properties; the numeric profile does not expose a mutable external realm object.

observableDone: Specify mutable builtin/realm object ownership and test mutation, reification and subsequent calls without bypassing lexical binding identity.
